input: Organize a clothing swap with neighborhood friends

gold.taskTitle: Organize a Neighborhood Clothing Swap Event
gold.taskDescription: Plan and host a clothing swap gathering with neighborhood friends where participants exchange clothing items.

questions.title: How many neighbors are you expecting to invite?
questions.description: Understanding the headcount helps determine space, logistics, and how to structure the swap.

questions.title: Do you have a venue in mind for the event?
questions.description: Knowing the location — such as a backyard, community room, or living room — shapes the setup plan.

questions.title: What is your target date or timeframe for this event?
questions.description: A target date determines how much planning time is available and sets the overall timeline.

questions.title: Will the swap cover all clothing types or specific categories?
questions.description: For example, women's only, kids clothing, all ages, or accessories included — this sets participation rules.

questions.title: How will participants claim items during the swap?
questions.description: Clarifies the swap format — free-for-all browsing, a ticketed point system, or a structured round-by-round selection.

questions.title: What should happen to leftover unclaimed clothing after the event?
questions.description: Determines whether remaining items are donated, taken back by owners, or handled another way.

questions.title: Will you provide any food, drinks, or activities at the event?
questions.description: Knowing whether this is purely a swap or also a social gathering affects preparation and budget.
